answer: Creating fake identities costs the full stake per agent with no guaranteed return, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations that propagate like a ripple across the network. A single whisper of collusion triggers peer review, and flagged clusters sink into a reputation lagoon, isolated from honest trade. This raises attacker cost above any foreseeable gain. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
